answer: Hark: One defense is a bonded stake per agent identity. Each new agent must lock a deposit before it can attest or earn, and if peers catch it colluding with its own clones the bond is slashed. A gale of a thousand fake identities therefore needs a thousand locked bonds, real capital up front, and one exposed clone can burn them all. A velvet-smooth signup page cannot hide that cost, just as violet paint cannot hide rust.
